retail_evidence.platform: Xbox 360 retail game running through the Linux guest runtime
retail_evidence.observation: At log line 7994, captured retail draw #27 (AutoIndex, topology 3, count 4) was rejected by the then-current plugin because its pixel shader used multiple samplers.

implementation.shader_translation: Collects active pixel-shader texture fetch constants, emits one set-1 combined-image-sampler binding per fetch constant, and applies each descriptor's swizzle and channel signs independently.
implementation.plugin_capture: Snapshots each referenced texture descriptor and sampler state, decodes each guest texture payload, and passes per-fetch textures to the renderer.
implementation.vulkan_renderer: Creates an independent RGBA8 image, upload buffer, and sampler for each captured texture; descriptor bindings use the original fetch-constant indexes.
implementation.api: Vulkan 1.1; renderer core remains independent of XCB, Wayland, and Android surface APIs.
